select
,f.thumb_nail_url as thumb_nail_url,s.fid as subId0 from gc_video v

#{subId}

, S."fid" AS subId0 ,s.id as sub_id FROM GC_SUBJECT S LEFT JOIN GC_VIDEO V ON S.ID = V.SUB_ID

#{subId}

SELECT
, S."fid" AS subId0, s.id as sub_id, S.id AS course_id, S.name AS course_name, S.fid AS course_fid, S.state AS course_state, S.available_type AS course_available_type, count(r.id) as resourceNum FROM gc_subject S JOIN course_content ON course_content.course_id = S.id JOIN gc_video v ON v.id = course_content.content_id left join gc_resource r on r.video_id = v.id
WHERE v.sub_id IN
#{subId}
GROUP BY v.id, f.id, S."fid", s.id order by v.order asc,v.create_time asc,v.id

, S."fid" AS subId0, s.id as sub_id, S.id AS course_id, S.name AS course_name, S.fid AS course_fid, S.state AS course_state, S.available_type AS course_available_type FROM course_content JOIN gc_subject s ON s.id = course_content.course_id JOIN gc_video V ON V.ID = course_content.content_id
WHERE course_content.course_id IN
#{subId}

select
, S."fid" AS subId0 from gc_video v
LEFT JOIN GC_SUBJECT S ON S.ID = V.SUB_ID where S.FID IN
#{subId}
and v.video_name like concat('%',#{videoName},'%')

select
, round(avg(star_value)::numeric,2) as starvalue, v.order, course.id AS course_id, course.name AS course_name, course.fid AS course_fid, course.state AS course_state, course.available_type AS course_available_type from course_content join gc_video v on v.id = course_content.content_id join gc_subject course on course.id = course_content.course_id
left join gc_user_video_action ac on ac.content_id = v.id where course_content.course_id=#{subId} group by course.id, v.id, f.id order by v."order" asc,v.create_time asc,v.id

select
,s.sub_id as top_sub_id,s.fid as subId0, file.id as f_id,file.name as f_name,file.folder as f_folder,file.file_url as f_file_url, file.file_type as f_file_type,file.file_type_index as f_file_type_index,file.master_id as f_master_id, file.save_type as f_save_type from gc_video v LEFT JOIN gc_subject s ON s.id=v.sub_id LEFT JOIN sys_file file on file.id = v.file_id WHERE 1=1
AND s.id in
#{subId}
order by v.order asc,v.create_time asc,v.id

,s.sub_id as top_sub_id,s.fid as subId0, file.id as f_id,file.name as f_name,file.folder as f_folder,file.file_url as f_file_url, file.file_type as f_file_type,file.file_type_index as f_file_type_index,file.master_id as f_master_id, file.save_type as f_save_type from gc_video v LEFT JOIN gc_subject s ON s.id=v.sub_id LEFT JOIN sys_file file on file.id = v.file_id left join gc_event event on event.video_id = v.id WHERE 1=1
AND s.sub_id in
#{subId}
order by v.order asc,v.create_time asc,v.id

, pc.channel_name as subjectName from gc_video v LEFT JOIN sys_file f ON v.file_id = f.id LEFT JOIN pt_channel pc ON v.origin_channel_id = pc.id LEFT JOIN content_group_channel_subscription channel_subscription ON channel_subscription.channel_id = pc.id LEFT JOIN gc_user_access ua ON ua.access_id = channel_subscription.content_group_id

#{subjectId}

, s2."fid" AS subId0 ,s2.id as sub_id, ap.id as permission_id from GC_SUBJECT s left join gc_user_access_permission ap on ap.sub_permission::jsonb @> to_jsonb(s.id::integer) left join gc_subject s2 on s2.fid = s.id LEFT JOIN GC_VIDEO V ON S2.ID = V.SUB_ID

select max(p.play_state) as play_state,v.id as id from gc_subject s left join gc_subject s2 on s2.fid = s.id left join gc_video v on v.sub_id = s2.id left join gc_user_video_play p on p.video_id = v.id and user_id = #{userId} where s.id = #{subId} and v.id is not null GROUP BY v.id
SELECT max( p.play_state ) AS play_state, v.id AS id FROM gc_video v LEFT JOIN gc_user_video_play p ON p.video_id = v.id AND user_id = #{userId} WHERE v.id = #{video} GROUP BY v.id

#{subIds}

SELECT
, CASE WHEN v.origin_channel_id IS NOT NULL THEN channel_owner.id ELSE course_owner.id END AS user_id, pc.id AS channel_id, pc.channel_name AS channel_channel_name, pc.channel_slug AS channel_channel_slug, pc.fid AS channel_fid, pc.visible_flag AS channel_visible_flag, pcc.id AS channel_channel_content_id, channel_owner.id AS channel_create_user_id, channel_owner_info.first_name AS channel_create_user_first_name, channel_owner_info.last_name AS channel_create_user_last_name, channel_owner_avatar.file_url AS channel_create_user_avatar_full_file_url, gs.id AS course_id, gs.name AS course_name, gs.fid AS course_fid, gs.state AS course_state, gs.available_type AS course_available_type, course_owner.id AS course_user_info_id, course_owner_info.first_name AS course_user_info_first_name, course_owner_info.last_name AS course_user_info_last_name, course_owner_avatar.file_url AS course_user_info_avatar_full_file_url FROM gc_video v JOIN sys_file f ON v.file_id = f.id
JOIN gc_user_access user_content_group ON user_content_group.user_id = f.upload_uid AND user_content_group.master_id = #{masterId} AND user_content_group.access_id IN
#{contentGroupId}
LEFT JOIN pt_channel pc ON v.origin_channel_id = pc.id LEFT JOIN pt_channel_content pcc ON pcc.content_id = v.id LEFT JOIN gc_user channel_owner ON pc.create_user_id = channel_owner.id LEFT JOIN gc_user_info channel_owner_info ON channel_owner.info_id = channel_owner_info.id LEFT JOIN sys_file channel_owner_avatar ON channel_owner_info.avatar_file_id = channel_owner_avatar.id
LEFT JOIN gc_subject gs ON v.origin_course_id = gs.id LEFT JOIN gc_user course_owner ON gs.create_user = course_owner.id LEFT JOIN gc_user_info course_owner_info ON course_owner.info_id = course_owner_info.id LEFT JOIN sys_file course_owner_avatar ON course_owner_info.avatar_file_id = course_owner_avatar.id WHERE ((gs.master_id = #{masterId} AND gs.state = 1 AND course_owner.id IS NOT NULL) OR (pc.master_id = #{masterId} AND pc.visible_flag != 0 AND channel_owner.id IS NOT NULL))
AND v.video_name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{filter.query}, '%')
ORDER BY v.create_time DESC

SELECT
, CASE WHEN v.origin_channel_id IS NOT NULL THEN channel_owner.id ELSE course_owner.id END AS user_id, (SELECT COUNT(id) FROM gc_video_comment WHERE video_id = v.id) AS comment_num, pc.id AS channel_id, pc.channel_name AS channel_channel_name, pc.channel_slug AS channel_channel_slug, pc.fid AS channel_fid, pc.visible_flag AS channel_visible_flag, pcc.id AS channel_channel_content_id, channel_owner.id AS channel_create_user_id, channel_owner_info.first_name AS channel_create_user_first_name, channel_owner_info.last_name AS channel_create_user_last_name, channel_owner_avatar.file_url AS channel_create_user_avatar_full_file_url, gs.id AS course_id, gs.name AS course_name, gs.fid AS course_fid, gs.state AS course_state, gs.available_type AS course_available_type, course_owner.id AS course_user_info_id, course_owner_info.first_name AS course_user_info_first_name, course_owner_info.last_name AS course_user_info_last_name, course_owner_avatar.file_url AS course_user_info_avatar_full_file_url FROM gc_video v JOIN sys_file f ON v.file_id = f.id
LEFT JOIN pt_channel pc ON v.origin_channel_id = pc.id LEFT JOIN pt_channel_content pcc ON pcc.content_id = v.id LEFT JOIN gc_user channel_owner ON pc.create_user_id = channel_owner.id LEFT JOIN gc_user_info channel_owner_info ON channel_owner.info_id = channel_owner_info.id LEFT JOIN sys_file channel_owner_avatar ON channel_owner_info.avatar_file_id = channel_owner_avatar.id
LEFT JOIN gc_subject gs ON v.origin_course_id = gs.id LEFT JOIN gc_user course_owner ON gs.create_user = course_owner.id LEFT JOIN gc_user_info course_owner_info ON course_owner.info_id = course_owner_info.id LEFT JOIN sys_file course_owner_avatar ON course_owner_info.avatar_file_id = course_owner_avatar.id WHERE v.file_id = #{fileId}

SELECT
, CASE WHEN v.origin_channel_id IS NOT NULL THEN channel_owner.id ELSE course_owner.id END AS user_id, (SELECT COUNT(id) FROM gc_video_comment WHERE video_id = v.id) AS comment_num, pc.id AS channel_id, pc.channel_name AS channel_channel_name, pc.channel_slug AS channel_channel_slug, pc.fid AS channel_fid, pc.visible_flag AS channel_visible_flag, channel_owner.id AS channel_create_user_id, channel_owner_info.first_name AS channel_create_user_first_name, channel_owner_info.last_name AS channel_create_user_last_name, channel_owner_avatar.file_url AS channel_create_user_avatar_full_file_url, gs.id AS course_id, gs.name AS course_name, gs.fid AS course_fid, gs.state AS course_state, gs.available_type AS course_available_type, course_owner.id AS course_user_info_id, course_owner_info.first_name AS course_user_info_first_name, course_owner_info.last_name AS course_user_info_last_name, course_owner_avatar.file_url AS course_user_info_avatar_full_file_url, f.target_lang_json as target_lang_json, gs.id as subId0, gs.name as topicName FROM gc_video v JOIN sys_file f ON v.file_id = f.id
LEFT JOIN pt_channel pc ON v.origin_channel_id = pc.id LEFT JOIN gc_user channel_owner ON pc.create_user_id = channel_owner.id LEFT JOIN gc_user_info channel_owner_info ON channel_owner.info_id = channel_owner_info.id LEFT JOIN sys_file channel_owner_avatar ON channel_owner_info.avatar_file_id = channel_owner_avatar.id
LEFT JOIN gc_subject gs ON v.origin_course_id = gs.id LEFT JOIN gc_user course_owner ON gs.create_user = course_owner.id LEFT JOIN gc_user_info course_owner_info ON course_owner.info_id = course_owner_info.id LEFT JOIN sys_file course_owner_avatar ON course_owner_info.avatar_file_id = course_owner_avatar.id where v.id in
#{videoId}

select video.id from gc_video video join pt_channel_content channel_content on video.id = channel_content.content_id where channel_content.channel_id in
#{channelId}

SELECT
, , f.upload_uid as user_id, pc.id AS channel_id, pc.channel_name AS channel_channel_name, pc.channel_slug AS channel_channel_slug, pc.fid AS channel_fid, pc.visible_flag AS channel_visible_flag, gs.id AS course_id, gs.name AS course_name, gs.fid AS course_fid, gs.state AS course_state, gs.available_type AS course_available_type, CASE WHEN v.origin_channel_id IS NOT NULL THEN channel_owner.id ELSE course_owner.id END AS user_id, (SELECT COUNT(id) FROM gc_video_comment WHERE video_id = v.id) AS comment_num FROM gc_user_save_content_follow playlist_follow JOIN gc_user_save_folder playlist ON playlist.id = playlist_follow.folder_id AND playlist.master_id = #{portalUser.masterId} JOIN gc_user_save_content playlist_content ON playlist_content.folder_id = playlist_follow.folder_id JOIN gc_video v ON playlist_content.content_id = v.id JOIN sys_file f ON v.file_id = f.id
LEFT JOIN pt_channel pc ON v.origin_channel_id = pc.id LEFT JOIN gc_user channel_owner ON pc.create_user_id = channel_owner.id
LEFT JOIN gc_subject gs ON v.origin_course_id = gs.id LEFT JOIN gc_user course_owner ON gs.create_user = course_owner.id WHERE playlist_follow.user_id = #{portalUser.userId} AND (playlist_follow.update_time < #{cursor.updateTime} OR (playlist_follow.update_time = #{cursor.updateTime} AND playlist_follow.id < #{cursor.id})) ORDER BY playlist_follow.update_time DESC, playlist_follow.id DESC
